name: Wizard Specialization
description: SRD: "If desired, a wizard may specialize in one school of magic... The wizard must choose whether to specialize and, if she does so, choose her specialty at 1st level." Specializing is optional — a wizard who takes no specialty is a universalist, keeps every school and prohibits none. Universal spells fall into no school and are never affected.

options.name: Abjuration
options.description: Protective spells: wards, barriers and dispelling. Gives up two other schools.

ability.name: Specialist Wizard (Abjuration)
ability.description: Prepares one additional abjuration spell of each spell level per day. +2 on Spellcraft checks made to learn abjuration spells. Specialty and prohibited schools are chosen at 1st level and never change.

options.name: Conjuration
options.description: Summoning, creation, healing and teleportation. Gives up two other schools.

ability.name: Specialist Wizard (Conjuration)
ability.description: Prepares one additional conjuration spell of each spell level per day. +2 on Spellcraft checks made to learn conjuration spells. Specialty and prohibited schools are chosen at 1st level and never change.

options.name: Divination
options.description: Information: detection, scrying and foresight. Gives up one other school.

ability.name: Specialist Wizard (Divination)
ability.description: Prepares one additional divination spell of each spell level per day. +2 on Spellcraft checks made to learn divination spells. Specialty and prohibited schools are chosen at 1st level and never change.

options.name: Enchantment

ability.name: Specialist Wizard (Enchantment)

options.name: Evocation
options.description: Manipulating energy to create damage or effects from nothing. Gives up two other schools.

ability.name: Specialist Wizard (Evocation)
ability.description: Prepares one additional evocation spell of each spell level per day. +2 on Spellcraft checks made to learn evocation spells. Specialty and prohibited schools are chosen at 1st level and never change.

options.name: Illusion

ability.description: Prepares one additional necromancy spell of each spell level per day. +2 on Spellcraft checks made to learn necromancy spells. Specialty and prohibited schools are chosen at 1st level and never change.

options.name: Transmutation
options.description: Changing the properties of a creature, object or condition. Gives up two other schools.

ability.name: Specialist Wizard (Transmutation)
ability.description: Prepares one additional transmutation spell of each spell level per day. +2 on Spellcraft checks made to learn transmutation spells. Specialty and prohibited schools are chosen at 1st level and never change.

name: Prohibited Schools
description: SRD: "she must also give up two other schools of magic (unless she chooses to specialize in divination)... A wizard can never give up divination to fulfill this requirement. Spells of the prohibited school or schools are not available to the wizard, and she can't even cast such spells from scrolls or fire them from wands." Divination is therefore not offered here. A wizard with no specialty prohibits nothing.
